**Current behavior**
When you add angular-material to the project it is not able to build since the upgrade of angular 4.1 -> 4.2.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**

1. Integrate angular-material ([minimal example](https://github.com/Karasuni/angular-seed/tree/material))
2. `npm i` and `npm run build.prod.rollup.aot`

You will receive the error:
```
{ Error: A module cannot import itself
    at error (...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\utils\error.js:2:14)
    at Module.error$1 [as error] (...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\Module.js:303:2)
    at ...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\Bundle.js:399:15
  code: 'CANNOT_IMPORT_SELF',
  pos: 166,
  loc: 
   { file: '...\\angular-seed\\dist\\tmp\\node_modules\\@angular\\material\\typings\\index.ngfactory.js',
     line: 5,
     column: 0 },
  frame: '3: import * as i2 from \'@angular/common\';\n4: import * as i3 from \'@angular/platform-browser\';\n5: import * as i4 from \'./index.ngfactory\';\n   ^\n6: import * as i5 from \'@angular/forms\';\n7: import * as i6 from \'@angular/http\';' }
```

**Affected version:** 71329709dc5fa463e6152908b9e9ca2f5ee72505

I'm not sure if the issue is sourced at `angular` or at `angular/material`. The issue was reported also at https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/17389 and https://github.com/steveblue/angular2-rollup/issues/18 but there is no solution yet.

I've compared with an earlier commit using angular 4.1 and [this version](https://github.com/Karasuni/angular-seed/tree/material-4.1) builds flawlessly.

**Current behavior**
When I try to build angular-material with angular >4.2 using rollup an import recursion is generated.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**

1. Integrate angular-material alongside angular 4.2 ([example](https://github.com/Karasuni/angular-seed/tree/material))
2. `npm i` and `npm run build.prod.rollup.aot`

You will receive the error:
```
{ Error: A module cannot import itself
    at error (...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\utils\error.js:2:14)
    at Module.error$1 [as error] (...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\Module.js:303:2)
    at ...\angular-seed\node_modules\rollup\src\Bundle.js:399:15
  code: 'CANNOT_IMPORT_SELF',
  pos: 166,
  loc: 
   { file: '...\\angular-seed\\dist\\tmp\\node_modules\\@angular\\material\\typings\\index.ngfactory.js',
     line: 5,
     column: 0 },
  frame: '3: import * as i2 from \'@angular/common\';\n4: import * as i3 from \'@angular/platform-browser\';\n5: import * as i4 from \'./index.ngfactory\';\n   ^\n6: import * as i5 from \'@angular/forms\';\n7: import * as i6 from \'@angular/http\';' }
```

Compare with [this version](https://github.com/Karasuni/angular-seed/tree/material-4.1) and notice that there are no issues up to angular 4.1.

* https://github.com/mgechev/angular-seed/issues/1970

issue.title: angular v4.2 broke aot compilation
issue.body:
angular v4.2 broke aot compilation for some things. Since the integration/package.json was set to minor v. ('^4.1.3') npm will install v4.2.2 which breaks the aot integration app. This PR sets the installs back to patch versions ('~4.1.3') to only install version 4.1.x until the issue is resolved in the angular project.

Anyhow, I believe the corresponding Angular issue is seen here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/17389
